changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Update cash_drawer_logs event_type constraint to include ADJUSTMENT_APPROVED, ADJUSTMENT_PENDING, and ADJUSTMENT_REJECTED enum values. This allows adjustment-related drawer events to be stored in the database.
changeSet.sql: -- Drop the existing constraint ALTER TABLE cash_drawer_logs DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS cash_drawer_logs_event_type_check;

-- Add updated constraint with ALL DrawerEventType enum values included (including new adjustment types) ALTER TABLE cash_drawer_logs ADD CONSTRAINT cash_drawer_logs_event_type_check CHECK (event_type::text = ANY (ARRAY[ 'OPENING_BALANCE'::character varying::text, 'SALE_INFLOW'::character varying::text, 'SALE_REFUND'::character varying::text, 'MANUAL_DEPOSIT'::character varying::text, 'MANUAL_WITHDRAWAL'::character varying::text, 'CLOSING_BALANCE'::character varying::text, 'ADJUSTMENT_APPROVED'::character varying::text, 'ADJUSTMENT_PENDING'::character varying::text, 'ADJUSTMENT_REJECTED'::character varying::text ]));
